nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry point for the Pet Care frontend application. Loads the React application via main.tsx and sets the page title to Pet Care.
nodes.languageNotes: Single-page app shell mounting React to the #root div.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm configuration for the Pet Care React frontend. Defines project metadata, scripts (dev, build, lint, format), and dependencies including React Router, React Query, Zustand, Zod, and Tailwind CSS.
nodes.languageNotes: ES module project (type: module) with React 18, TypeScript 5.3, Vite 5.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the frontend. Enables strict mode with ES2020 target, React JSX support, and path alias (@/) mapped to src/ directory.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses bundler moduleResolution, noEmit mode (Vite handles compilation), with strict type checking enabled.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build tool configuration for the Pet Care frontend. Configures React plugin, path alias (@/ -> src/), dev server on port 5173, and API proxy to backend at http://localhost:8080.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev server proxy forwards /api requests to Java backend (localhost:8080) for local development.
